proposal.frame: One known Cox/Chevron measurement control; at most two ascending canonical lease IDs from original attachment, selected before detailed matching
proposal.allowed_if_separately_approved: Free original documents only; dated court/title/cost/security and contemporaneous issuer/substitute comparison
proposal.prohibited: Paid PACER, account signup, other debtor, lease census, market data, economic testing, old source rescue or automatic F19 fallback

candidates.object: Shared exact private-credit loan across BDC filings
candidates.distinction: One lender's dated nonaccrual/contractual-income disclosure may reveal another listed holder's unreported economic exposure before its earnings, conditional on exact tranche and reporting-date identity.
candidates.decisive_limit: Exact co-holder cash-status increment and original schedules, not borrower-level mark differences

candidates.object: Property loan cash-management trigger and REIT upstream liquidity
candidates.distinction: A disclosed cash-trap covenant and same-loan servicer balances can distinguish trapped operating cash from an apparent improvement in property income.
candidates.decisive_limit: Covenant existence is not actual swept cash; cure and distribution outcome unjoined

candidates.distinction: A dated pathway-status or carbon-intensity change can alter legally eligible unit revenue at an identified producer, distinct from commodity-price or nameplate-volume exposure.
candidates.decisive_limit: CI/retroactive period disclosed; credit ownership, eligible backlog and realised project credits unavailable

candidates.object: Restaurant alcohol-tax receipts and retained corporate sales
candidates.distinction: A fixed-premise tax receipt can be real consumer demand yet accrue to a franchisee or different operator; dated control changes could alter the value of brand-level sales nowcasts.
candidates.decisive_limit: No original rows/public vintages, material retained parent-sales link or increment beyond provider

candidates.distinction: Heightened cash monitoring and documented funding conditions may change a listed college's funding gap without an immediate enrollment change.
candidates.decisive_limit: Additional 21-day restriction is real, but independent gap/outcome and public informational lead unestablished

candidates.distinction: A certified contractual milestone can change a listed operator's near-term collectible cash rather than its recurring operating revenue.
candidates.decisive_limit: Expected payment not receipt; correlated programme phases and immediate issuer interpretation

candidates.distinction: A carrier with a relevant waiver may avoid low-value flights needed to retain slots, unlike a carrier exposed only to the same demand shock.
candidates.decisive_limit: Accepted returns and net savings not acquired or measurable from waiver ceiling alone

candidates.object: Refinery emission-event updates and restart failure
candidates.distinction: A failed-restart or duration revision may add operational information beyond the initial outage, if a same-plant independent production outcome exists.
candidates.decisive_limit: No original revision/output control; close faster direct-monitoring substitute

candidates.distinction: An operator failure can transfer an observable demand to a former leaseholder rather than the current operator; retained liability and indemnity limits must be distinguished.
candidates.decisive_limit: One small Cox/Chevron as-of field check justified; no original court/title/cost/security historical join yet

candidates.object: Renewable-generator subsidy protection and negative-price regimes
candidates.distinction: Contract-vintage-specific exclusions can leave otherwise similar generation differently protected during negative-price episodes; a useful predictor must add more than restating the payment formula.
candidates.decisive_limit: Published formula and vendor model overlap; individual receipts and parent retained economics not established
